QUEBORRIN-INFESTED AUTTAINE INQUISITOR
CR 16

There is something more than just mortal steel in this auttaine—her looks seem icily confident. She wears a high peaked black cap decorated with a glowering steel stylized bird, and in one hand she grips a cane, weighing it across her other hand as if ready to lash out. Her auttaine steel is drawn away from her obvious features—veins of iron and mesh of metal pulling away into her body as though trying to conceal an even more ominous secret strength.

XP 76,800
Queborrin-infested auttaine inquisitor 17
LN Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +9; Senses snow vision; Perception +24

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 13, flat-footed 21 (+7 armor, +3 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 216 (17d8+136)
Fort +16, Ref +10, Will +16; +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
Defensive Abilities stalwart; Resist construct resistances, cold 30; SR 17

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor)
Melee +2 corrosive burst greatsword +20/+15/+10 (2d6+9/17–20 plus 1d6 acid)
Ranged pepperbox +17/+12/+7 (1d8/x4)
Special Attacks exploit weakness, greater bane (17 rounds/day), judgment 6/day (3 simultaneous), slayer, staff of order (8 rounds, 3/day)
Domain Spell-Like Abilities (CL 17th; concentration +21)

7/day—touch of law

Inquisitor Spell-Like Abilities (CL 17th; concentration +21)

At will—detect alignment, discern lies (17 rounds/day)

Inquisitor Spells Known (CL 17th; concentration +21)

6th (2/day)—cleanse, heal, overwhelming presence (DC 20)
5th (4/day)—greater command (DC 19), flame strike (DC 19), greater forbid action (DC 19), righteous might
4th (5/day)—cure critical wounds, divine power, fear (DC 18), fleshworm infestation (DC 18), forceful strike (DC 18)
3rd (6/day)—burst of speed, deadly juggernaut, dispel magic, heroism, invisibility purge, magic vestment
2nd (6/day)—delay disease, delay pain (DC 16), delay poison, enthrall (DC 16), hold person (DC 16), instant weapon
1st (6/day)—command (DC 15), invisibility alarm, longshot, sanctuary (DC 15), tireless pursuit, true strike
0 (at will)—acid splash, bleed (DC 14), brand (DC 14), create water, detect magic, guidance

Domain Law

TACTICS

Before Combat Corrosa always goes into combat with righteous might, invisibility alarm, heroism and overwhelming presence cast.

During Combat Corrosa knows she is formidable opponent, but regards herself as far, far more important than anyone else—Roth included. Corrosa is a leader and organizer first, fighter second. She takes firm charge of any lesser ranks, driving them to fight in tight teamwork formations, using whatever teamwork feats she is aware of. Corrosa then effectively leads from the back, shouting, ordering and sacrificing lesser beings to ensure that what is left for her to fight is weaker.

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 20, Con 22, Int 12, Wis 19, Cha 14
Base Atk +12; CMB +17; CMD 32 (36 vs. overrun, 36 vs. trip)
Feats Amateur Gunslinger, Choir Of Blades, Distracting Charge, Improved Critical (greatsword), Improved Iron Will, Intimidating Gaze, Iron Will, Martial Weapon Proficiency (greatsword), Outflank, Precise Strike, Toughness, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (greatsword), Weapon Versatility
Skills Acrobatics +19 (+23 to maintain balance, +15 to jump), Intimidate +30, Knowledge (arcana) +21, Perception +24, Sense Motive +32, Spellcraft +21
Languages Abyssal, Common
SQ construction points 8—natural armor 4, deadeye, monster lore +4, solo tactics, stern gaze +8, track +8
Gear potion of cure serious wounds (2), ring of the drake (frost), +1 balanced breastplate, +2 corrosive burst greatsword, belt of mighty constitution +2, pepperbox Purity officers’ uniform, adorned with medals of honor, including the greatest medal for bravery worth a total of 2,000 gp, hip flask depicting alien birds worth 125 gp.
